## Alert spine

POST to this workflow instead of sending mail when something needs a human **now**.

```
POST $WEBHOOK_URL/webhook/alert
{
  "source":   "disk-health",
  "severity": "critical|warning|info",
  "title":    "short headline",
  "message":  "what to do about it",
  "fingerprint": "optional, defaults to source:title",
  "resolved": false,
  "url":      "optional link"
}
```

Repeats of the same fingerprint are held down for 30m (critical), 4h (warning), 24h (info). An escalation always breaks through; a de-escalation never does.
